description: This pie chart, titled “Distribution of data source in the AttrEval-Simulation,” visually represents the proportion of data contributed by five distinct sources: ENTITYQUEST, HOTPOTQA, POPQA, TRIVIAQA, and WEBQUESTIO. The chart is divided into five colored slices, each labeled with its corresponding source name and percentage value. The largest segment, colored blue, corresponds to ENTITYQUEST at 26.0%. The second largest, red, is HOTPOTQA at 24.2%. The third largest, yellow, is POPQA at 21.6%. The fourth largest, orange, is TRIVIAQA at 22.7%. The smallest segment, a thin teal slice, is WEBQUESTIO at 3.6%. A fifth, very small gray slice labeled “1.9%” is positioned adjacent to the WEBQUESTIO slice but is not labeled with a source name. Each slice is accompanied by a line pointing to its label, and the percentages are clearly printed next to each source name. The chart includes a legend that maps the source names to their respective colors, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size from the top right, moving clockwise.
